[Intro]
[D5]

[Verse 1]
[D5]When will it rain, I feel the
heat burning through my shoes
Soft shoulders are getting harder
adding to my blues
Can't count the days gone by, can't
wish away the stain
On the life behind me
from which I came

[Pre-Chorus]

[F5]The heat is getting hotter

[C5]on it I remain When will it ra-

[C5]going insane When will it ra-
[Bb5]in I'm on the road that will ne-
[C5]ver take me home When will it

[Interlude]
[D5]rain

[D5]When will it rain my mouth is as
dry as desert sand
And I've tried to hide in every
corner of this land

that's what they say
